commands.summary: Open a Change on the current branch from an intent and record its starting profile.

args.name: <intent>
args.description: One sentence or a quoted paragraph; with --kind bug the reproduction.

flags.name: --kind
flags.description: Graph variant; default feature (T02 decision R-8). `review` is a review of work already on the branch, opened by `/bdk:cr` (T42).

flags.name: --profile
flags.description: Starting profile, judged by the calling skill; default small (R-profil).

flags.name: --reason
flags.description: Why this profile; written into the body of the profile assumption entry. Required with --profile tiny.

flags.name: --inferred
flags.description: The Change is opened on the user's behalf by another skill; stamped source: inferred (R-12).

flags.name: --base
flags.description: Only with `--kind review`: the commit the review starts from is `git merge-base HEAD <ref>`; default `origin/HEAD`.

commands.summary: The active Change at a glance: stage, graph state, gate status with pending review entries, parked options.
List Changes in this repository: active per branch, parked, archived.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Include archived Changes.

commands.summary: Bind an existing Change to the current branch or leave the parked state with a chosen option.

flags.name: --option
flags.description: Index of the option from the parked entry; required when the Change is parked.

flags.name: --profile
flags.description: Raise the profile mid-flight; never lowers it.

commands.summary: Park the active Change with a question or blocker entry, options and one resume command.

flags.name: --reason
flags.description: Becomes the summary of the question entry.

flags.name: --option
flags.description: Repeatable; at least one. Defaults are accept as debt, change decision X, split part.

commands.summary: Take over a Change whose previous session died with open tickets.

flags.name: --close-tickets
flags.description: Close every open ticket as not-run instead of refusing.

commands.summary: Pathspec commit of the Change directory: `chore(bdk): checkpoint <change>`.
Close the Change after the review gate: spec merge, learning routing, archive, PR summary.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Report what would be merged, routed and archived; write nothing.

commands.summary: Measure a git diff: changed files, lines and modules, as raw signals for the caller's own classification.

args.name: <range>
args.description: `<base>` measures the working tree (staged and unstaged tracked changes) against base; `<base>..<head>` measures committed history only. Default HEAD.

commands.summary: Compute the range and the reviewer groups of the next review round of the active Change.

flags.name: --full
flags.description: Review from the Change base, ignoring earlier review rounds.

flags.name: --base
flags.description: Review from `git merge-base HEAD <ref>`; for a branch stacked on another one.

commands.summary: The next ready artifact with its instruction, plus the gate status; the skill's entry point.
Why an artifact is in its state: the `requires` chain with each node's state and input hash.

args.name: <artifact>
args.description: Node id from pipeline.yaml, e.g. plan-verify, gate:design, execute-part:02.

commands.summary: Run an artifact's kind validator without marking it done.

args.name: <artifact>
args.description: Defaults to the artifact next returns.

commands.summary: Mark an artifact done after its validator passes and record the input hash.
Plan parts with state, task counts, size, dependencies and wave.
Validate a part and record the start transition; required before its first ticket.
Close a part: every task has a trailer commit and no ticket is open.
Split an oversized or parked part into two parts with the same dependencies.

args.name: <task-ids>
args.description: Comma-separated tasks that move to the new part.

commands.summary: Open a ticket for one loop iteration, or refuse with the next rung of the ladder.

args.name: <loop>
args.description: Loop kind from policy: task-redispatch, verify-fix, review-fix, verifier.

args.name: <target>
args.description: Task id for task-redispatch, part id for verify-fix, the Change id for review-fix, an artifact id for verifier.

flags.name: --escalate
flags.description: Open the round's one-shot escalation ticket (A-drabina); allowed only when the round's budget is used up or it oscillates.

commands.summary: Close a ticket with its outcome; check the diff, the evidence and the declared entries.

args.name: outcome
args.description: ok: done; fail: findings remain (fingerprints stored); not-run: the check could not be performed (P4).

flags.name: --envelope
flags.description: The subagent's envelope file; its entry ids are checked.

flags.name: --reason
flags.description: Required with not-run: which precondition was missing. Written as the record's body.

commands.summary: Tickets and attempt records, open first.
Append one ledger entry; the kernel stamps id, time, author and source.

args.name: <summary>
args.description: <= 120 characters.

flags.name: --ref
flags.description: Repeatable; at least one (file, symbol, part, task, rule or entry id).

flags.name: --body
flags.description: Markdown body; - reads it from stdin.

flags.name: --ticket
flags.description: The ticket the caller works under; required inside a dispatch and for `report`, sets source: agent:<role>.

flags.name: --category
flags.description: The entry's category; a verifier blocker needs one from policy.verifier.blocking-categories (P8).

flags.name: --review
flags.description: Mark the entry to be shown at the next gate.

flags.name: --applies
flags.description: Repeatable; only with learning. Default: the Files: of the ticket's task.

commands.summary: Store a role's report under its ticket.

flags.name: --ticket
flags.description: Required; the role and the report path come from the ticket's dispatch package.

commands.stdin: The report: a YAML frontmatter holding the envelope, then the Markdown body.

commands.summary: Ledger entries as summaries, filtered by type, status, review flag or reference.

flags.name: --review
flags.description: Only review: true entries.

flags.name: --since-ticket-start
flags.description: Only entries written at or after the ticket's `opened-at`.

commands.summary: One entry in full, by bare or qualified id.

args.name: <id>
args.description: L-xxxx or <changeId>/L-xxxx.

commands.summary: Set an entry's status (resolved, accepted, superseded) with a reason.

flags.name: --by
flags.description: Superseding entry; required with superseded.

commands.summary: Set the project-level triage level of a finding, blocker or observation.

args.name: <id>
args.description: A `finding`, `blocker` or `observation` entry.

args.name: level
args.description: The level (T42-T).

flags.name: --reason
flags.description: Required for `not-a-problem`.

commands.summary: Build the dispatch package file for a target, role and ticket.

args.name: <target>
args.description: The ticket's target: a task id, a part id, the Change id or an artifact id (`kernel-state`, Attempt record).

args.name: <role>
args.description: Role skill under skills/roles/: implementer, simplifier, verifier, design-verifier, reviewer, integration-reviewer, pr-reviewer, runner, scout, lead.

flags.name: --group
flags.description: A review group of a `review-fix` ticket (`kernel-cli`, Ticket references); the package becomes that group's package.

flags.name: --file
flags.description: Repeatable; only with `--group`. The group's files, repository-relative, usually the `files` of a group of `bdk review plan`.

flags.name: --part
flags.description: Only with `--group`. The plan part the group reviews; the package names its file as the contract to review against.

flags.name: --range
flags.description: Only with `--group`; required for `reviewer` and `integration-reviewer`. The reviewed range `<base>..<head>` from `bdk review plan`.

flags.name: --focus
flags.description: Only with `--group`; at most 500 characters. The user's focus for the round, embedded as given.

commands.summary: Print a dispatch package by path or ticket.

args.name: <ticket|path>
args.description: A ticket reference (`kernel-cli`, Ticket references), or a package path relative to the working directory or absolute.

commands.summary: Register verification evidence: a manifest with the tree hash and the hashes of the files.

args.name: <kind>
args.description: tests-scoped, lint, tests-full, lint-full, typecheck, ui-capture or a project-defined kind; `coverage` is recorded only by `bdk evidence coverage`.

args.name: <file>
args.description: Repeatable; the evidence files (reports, snapshots, captures).

flags.name: --ticket
flags.description: Required; a ticket reference; ties the evidence to the target, the role and the group.

flags.name: --cite
flags.description: Repeatable; JSON pointer into a measured file or file:line in a snapshot, required for pass.

commands.summary: Measure the coverage of the lines the Change added from a test tool's coverage report, and record it with the computed verdict.

args.name: <test-id>
args.description: The `id` of a `tools.test` entry with `coverage`.

args.name: <report>
args.description: The coverage report the entry's `coverage.command` wrote, in its `coverage.format`.

flags.name: --ticket
flags.description: Required; a ticket reference of an open ticket whose target is the Change.

commands.summary: Is the evidence for a target still fresh against the working tree?

args.name: <target|evidence-id>
args.description: A task, part or Change id, or an `E-` id.

commands.summary: Validate a spec delta: Scenario prefix, WHEN / THEN, no silent scenario loss.

args.name: <capability>
args.description: Default: every delta of the active Change.

commands.summary: Deterministically merge the Change's deltas into `.bdk/specs/`; refuse on conflict.
What the merged spec would look like: requirement-level diff of the Change's deltas against `.bdk/specs/`.
The resolved configuration after the four layers, with the origin of every key.

args.name: <key>
args.description: Dotted key; default the whole tree. An element of an array merged by `id` is addressed by its `id` as a path segment (`tools.test.unit.scoped`).

flags.name: --origins
flags.description: Annotate each leaf with the layer it came from.

commands.summary: Validate every layer against the module schema registry; name unknown keys.
Print the JSON Schema of the settings (the file committed under `schema/`) or of one module.

args.name: <module>
args.description: The root key of one registered module, e.g. `tools`.

flags.name: --url
flags.description: Print only the versioned raw URL used in the yaml-language-server modeline.

commands.summary: Set one key in the project, local or global layer after validating the result.

args.name: <key>
args.description: Dotted key; array elements merged by `id` are addressed by `id`.

args.name: <value>
args.description: YAML scalar or inline collection.

flags.name: --global
flags.description: Write the global layer file (`kernel-settings`, Configuration layers).

flags.name: --local
flags.description: Write .bdk/settings.local.yaml (gitignored).

commands.summary: Compose the prompt context a skill's context line injects: rule sets, language rules, fragments, tool entries, plugin files.

args.name: <name>
args.description: Skill name, e.g. debug, create-plan.

commands.summary: Render the STARTUP instructions, including the agents table generated from agent frontmatter (P11).
Read-only SQL over the rebuildable index.

args.name: <sql>
args.description: A single SELECT over the public tables of the index.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Lift the 100-row page.

commands.summary: Commit a task: code plus Change directory, with BDK trailers, after the diff check.

flags.name: --message
flags.description: Subject line; default the task title.

commands.summary: Check the rule files of the bundle and the project: ids, `[PREFIX-n]` format, frontmatter, `source` / `verified` on knowledge rules, tombstones, `rules.disabled`.

args.name: <path>
args.description: A rule file or directory; default .bdk/rules/ and the bundle's pack.

commands.summary: Print one rule by id, tombstones included, or the rules a ticket's active package records.

args.name: <id>
args.description: A rule id, e.g. BDK-CQ-4 or API-2. Exactly one of <id> and --ticket.

flags.name: --ticket
flags.description: Print the rules the ticket's active package records, in its order.

commands.summary: Adopt a rule: write `.bdk/rules/<PREFIX>-<n>.md` from the user's decision and regenerate the projection.

args.name: <text>
args.description: The rule text, one choice stated as an instruction; - reads stdin.

flags.name: --prefix
flags.description: An existing or new project prefix; never BDK.

flags.name: --kind
flags.description: Default house.

flags.name: --severity
flags.description: Default medium.

flags.name: --applies
flags.description: Repeatable; absent means global.

flags.name: --role
flags.description: Repeatable; absent means every rule-reading role.

flags.name: --from
flags.description: Repeatable; a qualified entry or ticket id the rule comes from.

flags.name: --source
flags.description: Where the fact comes from; required with --kind knowledge.

flags.name: --verified
flags.description: YYYY-MM-DD; required with --kind knowledge.

commands.summary: Which rules apply to a file for a role, and why.

flags.name: --role
flags.description: Default implementer.

commands.summary: List rules whose globs match no file or that no entry of the last N Changes cites.

flags.name: --uncited
flags.description: The most recent Changes to look back; default rules.prune.uncited-changes.

commands.summary: Import a project's `.claude/rules/*.md` into `.bdk/rules/`, one rule per top-level bullet, applies from `paths:`.

args.name: <dir>
args.description: Default .claude/rules/.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Report what would be written; write nothing.

flags.name: --prefix
flags.description: Override the prefix derived from the file name; one file only.

commands.summary: The audit view: recurring items across Changes, the raw findings and learnings, citations by rule id.

flags.name: --min-changes
flags.description: Distinct Changes an item must appear in; default rules.audit.min-changes.

flags.name: --entries
flags.description: Add the raw learning, finding and blocker entries and attempt findings.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Lift the 100-item limit of entries.

commands.summary: Generate the host projection of the project's rules: `.claude/rules/bdk-generated.md` and `bdk-generated-scoped.md`.

flags.name: --claude
flags.description: Target Claude Code (the only target in 3.0).

flags.name: --check
flags.description: Exit 2 when the committed projection is out of date; write nothing.

commands.summary: Generate a host's adapter files from the kernel's adapter definitions and the per-host tool map.

flags.name: --host
flags.description: Required. Claude Code is the only host in 3.0.

flags.name: --out
flags.description: Default the agents/ directory of the plugin root.

flags.name: --check
flags.description: Compare instead of writing; exit 2 when a generated file differs or is missing; write nothing.

commands.summary: SessionStart content hook: STARTUP text, configuration check, v2 layout detection, schema refresh.
SessionEnd content hook: Change checkpoint commit when enabled and safe, and the end of the session's run.
UserPromptExpansion guard: the only writer of `source: user` stage transitions and the start of a run.
PreToolUse guard: spec directory, subagent git, subagent kernel commands, `bdk.mjs hooks` from Bash, agent spawns, agent messages, and stage skills a model starts.
PostToolUse hook: link a spawned agent to its parent and record a killed agent.
SubagentStart hook: record the agent and hand it its identity.
SubagentStop hook: the continuation check for a subagent, then its end in the registry.
Stop hook: the continuation check for the main thread.
Skill-frontmatter UserPromptSubmit hook: warn as content when a named skill is not installed.

args.name: <name>
args.description: Skill name as in frontmatter, e.g. caveman-commit.

commands.stdin: UserPromptSubmit payload; only the presence of a name matters.

commands.summary: Diagnose the runtime, the layout and the state; one known repair action per finding.

flags.name: --fix
flags.description: Apply the repairs that need no system change (index rebuild, schema refresh, modeline); never installs software.

commands.summary: Rebuild the index and the derived progress from committed files and git trailers.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Every Change, not only the active one.

commands.summary: Kernel version, contract version, Node version.
The agents of the registry with their state, parent and package.

flags.name: --children-of
flags.description: Only the agents whose parent is this agent; `main` names the main thread.

flags.name: --affected-by
flags.description: Only the running agents whose package's target the entry names; needs the active Change.

flags.name: --state
flags.description: Only agents in this state.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Include ended agents.

commands.summary: One agent of the registry with its lifecycle signals and children.
Block until a child reports, ends or turns suspect, or a message arrives.

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: How long to block with nothing to report; default 300, at most 540.
